_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST CREDENTIALS FOR AUTOMATED F-02 ACCEPTANCE ONLY.
Committed on purpose so 'pnpm run test:e2e' is reproducible from a clean checkout on
any machine and in CI, without depending on an operator's private .env file.
These are demo-only values for the seeded synthetic accounts and are NOT secrets.
They must never become a runtime demo default, must never be copied into .env as a
production credential, and must not be presented as real user credentials.
The usernames are the seeded synthetic employees from docs/demo-data.json.
The passwords are arbitrary strings known only to this fixture and the test harness.
The API receives them through the Playwright webServer env option; see the browser
